decision.observation: 7:50 pm, Sat. 6; the C press reeled the line in; the bobber now hangs airborne near the rod tip at ~(0.62,0.07). The pond is directly below.
decision.hypothesis: Recasting will drop the bobber into the pond; the dip-then-C loop has produced catches twice today, so repeating it should yield another catch or start the bar minigame.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the minigame opens, use LMB holds/releases to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
